title: Four Arms
reference: repeat 4 { F1(9) turn_right } def F1 { if wall_ahead { turn_left turn_left } else { forward F1 forward } }
hints: F1 can stop itself: if there is a wall ahead, turn round. If not, step, call F1, and step again. The second step walks back.
F1: if wall ahead, turn left twice, else forward, F1, forward. Main: repeat 4 of F1(9), turn right.
repeat 4 { F1(9) turn_right } def F1 { if wall_ahead { turn_left turn_left } else { forward F1 forward } }

story.intro: PATCH: "The Nautilus Stair. Sensors are back, so F1 can stop at a wall instead of at depth zero. And every call remembers the way back."
story.outro: PATCH: "Each arm a different length, one function for all four. The calls counted the steps out, so they knew the steps back."
